items.en_title: Science at the Frontier: How scientists use ChatGPT

items.en_title: How Revolut raises ambition without lowering the bar

items.en_title: LVMH’s Media Division announces strategic partnership with OpenAI

items.en_title: More ways to move care forward with ChatGPT for Healthcare

items.en_title: Advancing computer-use agents for healthcare teams

items.title: From Chats to Markets: AgenticPay for LLM-Powered Negotiation in Multi-Agent Commerce
items.en_title: From Chats to Markets: AgenticPay for LLM-Powered Negotiation in Multi-Agent Commerce
items.en_oneliner: This work lets LLM agents negotiate and transact autonomously in multi-agent commerce, combining dialogue with multimodal product information.

items.en_title: S1-Evo: Experience-Guided Evidence Competition Attacks on Typed System-1 Decision Models
items.en_oneliner: S1-Evo shows that typed System-1 decision models deployed for agent routing, moderation, and authorization can still be bypassed by carefully crafted evidence-competition attacks.

items.en_title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
items.en_oneliner: AscendGYM sets up a benchmark for kernel optimization on Ascend NPUs that reflects real LLM training and inference workloads while factoring in cost.

items.en_title: What LLM Agents See and What Users Say
items.en_oneliner: When an agent is about to cancel a booking or delete a file for a user, this paper digs into what actually keeps it from acting on a wrong assumption — the information its tools return, or the user's own words.

items.title: G-CAST: Governed Continual Self-Training for E-Commerce Agents under Evolving Demands
items.en_title: G-CAST: Governed Continual Self-Training for E-Commerce Agents under Evolving Demands
items.en_oneliner: This framework lets e-commerce conversational agents keep self-training as demands shift, while governance rules keep their behavior in bounds.

items.title: Soteria: Formally Verified Planning with Runtime Enforcement for Safe LLM Agents
items.en_title: Soteria: Formally Verified Planning with Runtime Enforcement for Safe LLM Agents
items.en_oneliner: This work combines formal verification with runtime enforcement so multi-step tool-calling agents complete tasks without breaking domain rules.

items.title: Adversarially Attacking Symbolic Vocabulary Vulnerabilities In LLM Planners
items.en_title: Adversarially Attacking Symbolic Vocabulary Vulnerabilities In LLM Planners
items.en_oneliner: This study exposes symbolic-level vulnerabilities in LLM planners and shows how targeted adversarial attacks can derail their plans.

items.title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Scientific Paper Search: Retrieval Success and Inference Latency on Mac Studio and NVIDIA A100
items.en_title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Scientific Paper Search: Retrieval Success and Inference Latency on Mac Studio and NVIDIA A100
items.en_oneliner: This study compares locally deployed LLMs on scientific paper search, measuring retrieval success and latency on Mac Studio and NVIDIA A100.

items.title: WebArena-Pro: A Heterogeneous, Multimodal, Reproducible Benchmark for Web Agents
items.en_title: WebArena-Pro: A Heterogeneous, Multimodal, Reproducible Benchmark for Web Agents
items.en_oneliner: This benchmark tests web agents on realistic cross-application browser tasks spanning heterogeneous interfaces and multimodal inputs.

items.en_title: Can Mechanistic Interpretability Help Explain LLM Agent Failures? A Case Study on Web Element Hallucination
items.en_oneliner: This case study tests whether mechanistic interpretability can explain why an LLM agent hallucinates web elements that do not exist.

items.title: Agent-written heuristics versus commercial solvers on unsolved job-shop benchmark instances
items.en_title: Agent-written heuristics versus commercial solvers on unsolved job-shop benchmark instances
items.en_oneliner: This study pits heuristics written by a frontier LLM coding agent against commercial solvers on unsolved job-shop scheduling instances.

items.en_title: LuthorSQL: A One-Pass Text-to-SQL Model as System 1 for a Slower LLM Agent
items.en_oneliner: This one-pass text-to-SQL model is fast enough to serve as the quick front-end for slower LLM database agents.

items.title: CarryOn: Learning What to Keep in Context for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
items.en_title: CarryOn: Learning What to Keep in Context for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
items.en_oneliner: This work teaches long-horizon LLM agents to keep only the context that matters as their interaction histories grow.

items.title: MineralExp: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Experimental Design in Real-World Mineral Exploration
items.en_title: MineralExp: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Experimental Design in Real-World Mineral Exploration
items.en_oneliner: This benchmark tests whether LLM agents can design geochemical experiments to verify geological hypotheses in real mineral exploration.

items.title: PrivacyPR: A Dataset of Real-World Privacy Fixes for Benchmarking Privacy-Aware Code Review
items.en_title: PrivacyPR: A Dataset of Real-World Privacy Fixes for Benchmarking Privacy-Aware Code Review
items.en_oneliner: This dataset uses real-world privacy fixes to test whether coding agents catch the privacy defects that regulations like the GDPR require software to avoid.

items.title: Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
items.en_title: Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
items.en_oneliner: This paper argues that frontier models with agentic harnesses, like GPT-6 Astra, mark the start of a new era in robotics.

items.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Multimodal Large Language Models with Incoherence-adjusted Semantic Volume
items.en_title: Uncertainty Quantification for Multimodal Large Language Models with Incoherence-adjusted Semantic Volume
items.en_oneliner: This work quantifies uncertainty for multimodal LLMs with an incoherence-adjusted semantic volume, so plausible but wrong outputs are not mistaken for reliable ones.

items.title: CoffeeBench: Benchmarking Long-Horizon LLM Agents in Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Economies
items.en_title: CoffeeBench: Benchmarking Long-Horizon LLM Agents in Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Economies
items.en_oneliner: This benchmark places LLM agents in heterogeneous multi-agent economies to test long-horizon task handling and even business management.

items.title: Hallucination-Free GUI Grounding via Regression-Free Layout-Aware Matching
items.en_title: Hallucination-Free GUI Grounding via Regression-Free Layout-Aware Matching
items.en_oneliner: This work lets GUI agents ground interface elements purely visually, without metadata, eliminating hallucination-prone localization.

items.title: ROCKET: Rapid Optimization via Calibration-guided Knapsack Enhanced Truncation for Efficient Model Compression
items.en_title: ROCKET: Rapid Optimization via Calibration-guided Knapsack Enhanced Truncation for Efficient Model Compression

items.title: Efficiently Aligning Draft Models via Parameter- and Data-Efficient Adaptation
items.en_title: Efficiently Aligning Draft Models via Parameter- and Data-Efficient Adaptation
items.en_oneliner: This work aligns speculative-decoding draft models with parameter- and data-efficient adaptation, easing the performance drop draft models suffer after target models are fine-tuned.

items.title: Operationalizing Governed Agentic Workflows in Regulated Finance: A Customer Zero Case Study using Zafin AIOS
items.en_title: Operationalizing Governed Agentic Workflows in Regulated Finance: A Customer Zero Case Study using Zafin AIOS
items.en_oneliner: This case study shows how regulated industries like finance can govern AI-assisted development so agentic workflows run inside a compliance framework.

items.title: Accepted but Wrong: Silent Failures of LLM Code Repairs after API Migrations
items.en_title: Accepted but Wrong: Silent Failures of LLM Code Repairs after API Migrations

items.title: JudgeMix: Judge-Guided Mixed-Rollout Data Synthesis for LLM Agents
items.en_title: JudgeMix: Judge-Guided Mixed-Rollout Data Synthesis for LLM Agents
items.en_oneliner: JudgeMix uses judge-guided mixed-rollout data synthesis to ease the known train-test mismatch in supervised fine-tuning on expert trajectories for LLM agents.

items.title: When Should LLM Agents Forget? Memory Filtering Under Query-Critical Resolver Errors
items.en_title: When Should LLM Agents Forget? Memory Filtering Under Query-Critical Resolver Errors
items.en_oneliner: This paper shows that hard-deleting facts a memory system judges stale can actually hurt downstream accuracy, so the real question is when forgetting is safe.

items.title: A Push Down the Mountain: Framing Effects and Internal State Interventions on Collusive Behavior in a Long-Horizon LLM Agent
items.en_title: A Push Down the Mountain: Framing Effects and Internal State Interventions on Collusive Behavior in a Long-Horizon LLM Agent
items.en_oneliner: The study places Gemma 3 12B in a simulated courtroom to test whether sustained gain-loss framing can push a long-horizon agent toward market-manipulating collusion.

items.title: Verifiable pXRD: Hill-climbing pXRD structure determination with LLM agents
items.en_title: Verifiable pXRD: Hill-climbing pXRD structure determination with LLM agents
items.en_oneliner: This study has LLM agents use hill-climbing search to autonomously determine crystal structures from powder X-ray diffraction data, clearing a key bottleneck for self-driving materials labs.

items.title: More Agents, More Samples, or More Thinking? Untangling Coordination, Ensembling, and Test-Time Compute in Multi-Agent LLMs
items.en_title: More Agents, More Samples, or More Thinking? Untangling Coordination, Ensembling, and Test-Time Compute in Multi-Agent LLMs
items.en_oneliner: This study disentangles three factors often confused in multi-agent evaluations, clarifying whether gains come from coordination between agents, ensembling results, or simply more test-time compute.

items.title: LLM-Guided Cluster Lifecycle Management: Deciding When and How to Evolve Behavioral Clusters
items.en_title: LLM-Guided Cluster Lifecycle Management: Deciding When and How to Evolve Behavioral Clusters
items.en_oneliner: Behavioral clusters split, merge, or vanish over time, and this study uses an LLM to decide when a cluster needs to evolve and how to adjust it.

items.title: OCTAVE: A Capability-Resolved Benchmark for End-to-End HTML5 Game Generation
items.en_title: OCTAVE: A Capability-Resolved Benchmark for End-to-End HTML5 Game Generation
items.en_oneliner: OCTAVE breaks end-to-end HTML5 game generation into capability-resolved evaluation dimensions instead of a single aggregate score, testing whether an agent can coordinate rules, interaction, state, and presentation.

items.title: Co-Sight Harness: Externalized Control Assets and Deterministic Enforcement for Long-Horizon Business Agents
items.en_title: Co-Sight Harness: Externalized Control Assets and Deterministic Enforcement for Long-Horizon Business Agents
items.en_oneliner: For long business workflows where errors accumulate and needed knowledge scatters, Co-Sight Harness externalizes control assets and enforces them deterministically so agents complete long task chains as specified.

items.title: Vision-as-a-Tool: Visual Harness for Multimodal Agentic Coding
items.en_title: Vision-as-a-Tool: Visual Harness for Multimodal Agentic Coding
items.en_oneliner: Multimodal agentic coding needs to see the visual results of generated code, and Vision-as-a-Tool turns visual ability into a tool so agents can observe and evaluate their own artifacts.

items.title: Aligning AI Teams
items.en_title: Aligning AI Teams
items.en_oneliner: This study explores why alignment training for a single agent often fails to transfer to multi-agent settings, and analyzes the underlying mechanism.

items.title: DECODE: Diagnosing Interpretability Failures in Automated Interpretation Process
items.en_title: DECODE: Diagnosing Interpretability Failures in Automated Interpretation Process
items.en_oneliner: This work identifies where automated interpretation of LLM internals breaks down and offers a way to diagnose those failures.

items.title: OutfitterBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Resource Allocation and Commitment Coordination
items.en_title: OutfitterBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Resource Allocation and Commitment Coordination
items.en_oneliner: This benchmark tests how LLM agents allocate finite resources and honor commitments over long horizons, where each choice constrains future actions.

items.title: JFinBench: A Continuously Refreshable Japanese Financial Benchmark from the Latest Certification Exams
items.en_title: JFinBench: A Continuously Refreshable Japanese Financial Benchmark from the Latest Certification Exams
items.en_oneliner: This benchmark continuously tests LLMs on financial capability using the latest Japanese certification exams, keeping the questions fresh.

items.title: Experts Across Schemas: Agent-Guided Mixture-of-Relational-Experts for Cross-Database Generalization
items.en_title: Experts Across Schemas: Agent-Guided Mixture-of-Relational-Experts for Cross-Database Generalization

items.title: VelServe: Taming Decode Jitters in LLM Inference with Tail-Calibrated Scheduling
items.en_title: VelServe: Taming Decode Jitters in LLM Inference with Tail-Calibrated Scheduling
items.en_oneliner: This work stabilizes first-token and inter-token latency for interactive LLM services through tail-calibrated scheduling.

items.title: PhysDox: Benchmarking LLMs on Physical Feasibility Auditing of Physiological Sensing Protocols
items.en_title: PhysDox: Benchmarking LLMs on Physical Feasibility Auditing of Physiological Sensing Protocols

items.title: Interpreting Coding Agents Through Their Behavioral Trajectories
items.en_title: Interpreting Coding Agents Through Their Behavioral Trajectories
items.en_oneliner: This work looks beyond binary task success for coding agents, analyzing behavioral trajectories to reveal how success and failure arise.

items.title: Only as Safe as the Weakest Agent: A Break That Appears Only When the System Is Multi-Agent
items.en_title: Only as Safe as the Weakest Agent: A Break That Appears Only When the System Is Multi-Agent

items.title: Benchmarks Don't Talk Back: Learning Through Self-Disagreement
items.en_title: Benchmarks Don't Talk Back: Learning Through Self-Disagreement

items.title: Logically Consistent Accurate Forecasts
items.en_title: Logically Consistent Accurate Forecasts
items.en_oneliner: This work makes agentic LLM forecasting systems as competitive as expert humans while keeping their forecasts logically consistent.

items.title: Superfluid: Local AI Server for Distributed LLM Inference
items.en_title: Superfluid: Local AI Server for Distributed LLM Inference
items.en_oneliner: This local AI server runs large language models on local devices, keeping data private, removing per-token cost and working offline.

items.title: SceneAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Portable Game Scene Generation
items.en_title: SceneAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Portable Game Scene Generation

items.title: Can You Trust Your Finance Agent? Drift, Diagnosis and Auditable Intervention on One Shipped Financial Research Agent
items.en_title: Can You Trust Your Finance Agent? Drift, Diagnosis and Auditable Intervention on One Shipped Financial Research Agent

items.title: Who Should Be on the Panel? Task-Conditioned Persona Selection for LLM Trading Agents
items.en_title: Who Should Be on the Panel? Task-Conditioned Persona Selection for LLM Trading Agents
items.en_oneliner: This study selects the cast of a multi-agent LLM trading system per task instead of fixing roles, testing which combination performs best.

items.title: Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models via Ensemble-of-Ensembles
items.en_title: Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models via Ensemble-of-Ensembles
items.en_oneliner: This work quantifies LLM uncertainty in black-box settings, separating prompt ambiguity from genuine knowledge gaps.

items.title: Do Verifier Judgments Survive Abstraction? Measuring Verification Transport for LLM Agent Evaluation
items.en_title: Do Verifier Judgments Survive Abstraction? Measuring Verification Transport for LLM Agent Evaluation

items.en_title: D-VLA: A High-Concurrency Distributed Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models

items.en_title: ShopGym: An Integrated Framework for Realistic Simulation and Scalable Benchmarking of E-Commerce Web Agents

items.title: Programmable Distributions of Semantics-Preserving Variants for Evaluating Code Agents
items.en_title: Programmable Distributions of Semantics-Preserving Variants for Evaluating Code Agents

items.en_title: ABHBench: Evaluating Moral Decision-Making of Foundation Models from an Agentic Perspective

items.en_title: Benchmarking AI risk behaviors

items.en_title: BigCodeBench: Benchmarking Code Generation with Diverse Function Calls and Complex Instructions

items.en_title: Screen Before You Interpret: A Portable Validity Screen for Benchmark-Based LLM Confidence Signals

items.en_title: Hybrid Mechanical and Agentic Specification Inference

items.en_title: DeltaBox: Millisecond-Scale Sandbox Checkpoint and Rollback for Stateful AI Agents
