items.title: REFORGE: A Method for Benchmarking LLMs' Reverse Engineering Capabilities in Decompiled Binary Function Naming
items.en_title: REFORGE: A Method for Benchmarking LLMs' Reverse Engineering Capabilities in Decompiled Binary Function Naming
items.en_oneliner: REFORGE benchmarks LLM reverse-engineering capability through decompiled binary function naming, responding to real threat-intelligence reports of LLMs being used for reverse engineering.

items.title: CPM-MultiAgent: A CPM-Grounded Appraisal Framework for Simulating Dynamic Patient Emotional Evolution in Healthcare Dialogue
items.en_title: CPM-MultiAgent: A CPM-Grounded Appraisal Framework for Simulating Dynamic Patient Emotional Evolution in Healthcare Dialogue
items.en_oneliner: This framework uses multiple agents to simulate how patient emotions evolve in healthcare dialogue, helping train clinical communication skills.

items.title: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization
items.en_title: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization
items.en_oneliner: This work enables cloud and edge LLMs to learn collaboratively by accelerating personalized bilevel optimization, supporting distributed training for physical-world intelligence.

items.title: Cross-Benchmark Transfer from RL on Agentic Coding Tasks
items.en_title: Cross-Benchmark Transfer from RL on Agentic Coding Tasks
items.en_oneliner: Coding agents often stumble at the finish line — most of a feature built, yet a requirement dropped or tests left incomplete — and RL trained on coding tasks carries across benchmarks, the study finds.

items.title: Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks
items.en_title: Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks
items.en_oneliner: Agentic-OPD recovers agent capabilities forgotten during training by using on-policy distillation, countering the common practice of keeping only the best-validation result in RL for agentic tasks.

items.title: CastWorld: Benchmarking Context-Aware Agentic Time Series Forecasting Beyond Predictive Accuracy
items.en_title: CastWorld: Benchmarking Context-Aware Agentic Time Series Forecasting Beyond Predictive Accuracy
items.en_oneliner: CastWorld moves agentic time-series forecasting beyond single-shot number prediction toward self-directed, context-aware interaction, and judges it on more than accuracy alone.

items.title: Does the Ranking Hold? A Practitioner-Facing Audit of Hallucination Detectors on Small, Quantized, On-Device LLMs
items.en_title: Does the Ranking Hold? A Practitioner-Facing Audit of Hallucination Detectors on Small, Quantized, On-Device LLMs
items.en_oneliner: Aimed at real deployments, this study tests whether leading hallucination detectors still hold up on small, quantized on-device models, giving practitioners measured evidence for choosing one.

items.title: An Operationalization of Opaque Serial Depth
items.en_title: An Operationalization of Opaque Serial Depth
items.en_oneliner: This paper gives an operational definition of opaque serial depth, measuring how invisible a model's internal reasoning becomes when architectural shifts make chain-of-thought monitoring harder.

items.title: Advancing Quantization for R&R Models with Microscaling Formats
items.en_title: Advancing Quantization for R&R Models with Microscaling Formats
items.en_oneliner: This study applies microscaling formats to quantize recommendation and ranking models, boosting inference throughput for high-concurrency settings like advertising while preserving accuracy.

items.title: Model Annealing: Data-Efficient Learning through Review and Consolidation
items.en_title: Model Annealing: Data-Efficient Learning through Review and Consolidation
items.en_oneliner: Model annealing borrows the idea of review and consolidation, letting a small labeled dataset be reused through training instead of merely memorized, so the model learns more from less data.

items.title: Generated Evaluation Suites as Diversity-Driven Search for Real Agent Regressions
items.en_title: Generated Evaluation Suites as Diversity-Driven Search for Real Agent Regressions
items.en_oneliner: This study treats evaluation-suite generation as diversity-driven search, covering a descriptor space of requirements and personas to systematically uncover real regressions in agents.

items.title: Learn then Bet: Learning Interpretable Rules for Reliable Agent Intervention
items.en_title: Learn then Bet: Learning Interpretable Rules for Reliable Agent Intervention
items.en_oneliner: For autonomous agents that run for hundreds of steps, this study first learns interpretable intervention rules and then acts on them at the right moments to make long runs more reliable.

items.title: Aligned, Conflicting, or Unspecified? A Diagnostic Benchmark for Multimodal Time Series Forecasting
items.en_title: Aligned, Conflicting, or Unspecified? A Diagnostic Benchmark for Multimodal Time Series Forecasting
items.en_oneliner: When IoT time series meet external text like expert reports, this benchmark diagnoses how forecasting models behave when those signals agree, conflict, or go unspecified.

items.title: Certified Improvements to Best-Known Thomson-Problem Configurations with a Search Pipeline Built with Large Language Model Agents
items.en_title: Certified Improvements to Best-Known Thomson-Problem Configurations with a Search Pipeline Built with Large Language Model Agents
items.en_oneliner: The team built a search pipeline with LLM agents that improves the best-known configurations for the classic Thomson problem of arranging charges on a sphere, with certified verification.

items.title: AutoRL: A Multi-Agent System towards Autonomous Reinforcement Learning
items.en_title: AutoRL: A Multi-Agent System towards Autonomous Reinforcement Learning
items.en_oneliner: AutoRL uses a multi-agent system to automate reinforcement learning itself, aiming for AI systems that run their own RL training pipelines toward recursive self-improvement.

items.title: MASTARS: Multi-Agent Sequential Trajectory Augmentation with Return-Conditioned Subgoals
items.en_title: MASTARS: Multi-Agent Sequential Trajectory Augmentation with Return-Conditioned Subgoals
items.en_oneliner: Offline multi-agent reinforcement learning is limited by the quality of its fixed dataset, and MASTARS augments trajectories with return-conditioned subgoals to improve learning.

items.title: Robustness Evaluation of GPU Cloud Pricing Benchmarks under Incomplete Observations: A Controlled Missingness Study
items.en_title: Robustness Evaluation of GPU Cloud Pricing Benchmarks under Incomplete Observations: A Controlled Missingness Study
items.en_oneliner: When GPU rental marketplace quotes go missing, daily price benchmarks can distort, and this study stress-tests the common median rule under four controlled missingness patterns.

items.title: Is Abliteration Getting Harder? Not Uniformly: Refusal Removal by Direction-Based Ablation and ARA in Heretic on the Qwen3.8, Gemma 4, Olmo 3.1 and Mistral Small 3.2 LLMs Versus Their Predecessors
items.en_title: Is Abliteration Getting Harder? Not Uniformly: Refusal Removal by Direction-Based Ablation and ARA in Heretic on the Qwen3.8, Gemma 4, Olmo 3.1 and Mistral Small 3.2 LLMs Versus Their Predecessors
items.en_oneliner: This study tests how hard it is to strip refusal behavior from Qwen3.8, Gemma 4, Olmo 3.1 and Mistral Small 3.2, comparing them with their predecessors.

items.title: When Cooperation Must Change: Semantic Strategy Unlearning in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.en_title: When Cooperation Must Change: Semantic Strategy Unlearning in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.en_oneliner: This study lets multi-agent systems actively unlearn outdated cooperation strategies and relearn how to coordinate.

items.title: The Transformer Paradigm: Dynamic Processing and a New Principle of Inference
items.en_title: The Transformer Paradigm: Dynamic Processing and a New Principle of Inference
items.en_oneliner: This paper argues the Transformer revolution is not merely quantitative growth in deep learning but the emergence of a new principle of inference.

items.title: TotalSegmentator Aorta Report: Automated Aortic Diameter Measurement at 11 Standardized Landmarks on CT Images
items.en_title: TotalSegmentator Aorta Report: Automated Aortic Diameter Measurement at 11 Standardized Landmarks on CT Images
items.en_oneliner: This open-source tool automatically measures aortic diameters at 11 standardized landmarks on CT images for clinical assessment.

items.title: A$^3$: Adaptive Audio Agent Framework for Collaborative Edge Computing
items.en_title: A$^3$: Adaptive Audio Agent Framework for Collaborative Edge Computing
items.en_oneliner: This framework lets embedded audio agents keep working locally when the link fails and use a nearby edge server for speed when connected.

items.title: Do Machines Learn Deviance From Their Peers? A Randomized Test of Differential Association With AI Agents
items.en_title: Do Machines Learn Deviance From Their Peers? A Randomized Test of Differential Association With AI Agents
items.en_oneliner: This randomized test checks whether AI agents, like people, pick up rule-breaking behavior and its justifications from their peers.

items.title: Large Language Model-Empowered Intelligent Agent for Adaptive Fast-Charging Control of Lithium-Ion Batteries
items.en_title: Large Language Model-Empowered Intelligent Agent for Adaptive Fast-Charging Control of Lithium-Ion Batteries
items.en_oneliner: This work lets an LLM-powered agent dynamically balance charging speed against energy throughput to control lithium-ion fast charging.

items.title: Dancing Tokens on the Vocabulary Network from LLM Generation
items.en_title: Dancing Tokens on the Vocabulary Network from LLM Generation
items.en_oneliner: Starting from the geometry of the vocabulary network, the study explains how a specific LLM output, generated word by word, connects back to pre-training.

items.title: When evaluation becomes intervention in clinical AI
items.en_title: When evaluation becomes intervention in clinical AI
items.en_oneliner: This study shows that when AI judges grade clinical AI output, the evaluation itself changes clinical workflows and becomes an intervention.

items.title: Smart Home Agents Make Capable but Unpredictable Grid Operators
items.en_title: Smart Home Agents Make Capable but Unpredictable Grid Operators
items.en_oneliner: This study finds AI-enabled smart homes are becoming common at the grid edge, yet their failure-response behavior is hard to predict — a critical risk.

items.title: LECAT: Measuring LLM Category Learning from Pretraining Data
items.en_title: LECAT: Measuring LLM Category Learning from Pretraining Data
items.en_oneliner: This benchmark measures how LLMs acquire category knowledge from pre-training data, such as knowing airplanes are fast but broken ones are not.

items.title: When to Trust Simulated Patient Responses:Support-Gated World Models for Vasopressor Decision Support
items.en_title: When to Trust Simulated Patient Responses:Support-Gated World Models for Vasopressor Decision Support
items.en_oneliner: This study adds a support gate to clinical world models so agents do not trust simulated patient responses when the evidence is thin.

items.title: Typing Matters: Muscle, Language and Typing Behaviour in Live Keystroke Decoding from sEMG
items.en_title: Typing Matters: Muscle, Language and Typing Behaviour in Live Keystroke Decoding from sEMG
items.en_oneliner: This study recovers typed text from wrist surface EMG signals and shows muscle, language and typing habits all affect decoding accuracy.

items.title: ARCHER: From Rationale Imitation to Executable Reasoning in Small Language Models
items.en_title: ARCHER: From Rationale Imitation to Executable Reasoning in Small Language Models
items.en_oneliner: This work moves small language models from imitating reasoning traces to executable reasoning, making them more reliable on math tasks.

items.title: Alignment by Socialization: Learning Tradeoffs Under Selection
items.en_title: Alignment by Socialization: Learning Tradeoffs Under Selection
items.en_oneliner: This study takes an evolutionary view of how AI agents learn to trade off task completion against rules of conduct when the two conflict.

items.title: ModHarness-RL: Recasting Harnesses as Learnable and Evolving Programs for Agentic RL
items.en_title: ModHarness-RL: Recasting Harnesses as Learnable and Evolving Programs for Agentic RL
items.en_oneliner: This work turns the harness in agentic reinforcement learning from a fixed scaffold into a learnable, evolving program.

items.title: Imitation Bootstrapped Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.en_title: Imitation Bootstrapped Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.en_oneliner: This work extends demonstration-based learning to multi-agent reinforcement learning so agents learn to cooperate faster from examples.

items.title: HARDTESTGEN: A High-Quality RL Verifier Generation Pipeline for LLM Algorithmic Coding
items.en_title: HARDTESTGEN: A High-Quality RL Verifier Generation Pipeline for LLM Algorithmic Coding
items.en_oneliner: This pipeline automatically generates high-quality verifiers that provide reliable reward signals for RL on LLM algorithmic coding.

items.title: ProdPilot: A Layered Model Context Protocol System for Automated Production Readiness and Deployment of Vibe-Coded Projects
items.en_title: ProdPilot: A Layered Model Context Protocol System for Automated Production Readiness and Deployment of Vibe-Coded Projects
items.en_oneliner: This layered MCP system checks AI-assisted vibe-coded projects and automatically brings them to production readiness.

items.title: Time-Consistent Evaluation of Hierarchical Code Graphs for SWE Agents
items.en_title: Time-Consistent Evaluation of Hierarchical Code Graphs for SWE Agents
items.en_oneliner: This work requires SWE agent evaluation to strictly separate pre-existing repository knowledge from future code evolution to avoid temporal leakage.

items.title: Confident and Wrong: Structure Confidence Is a Poor Selection Filter for Protein Function
items.en_title: Confident and Wrong: Structure Confidence Is a Poor Selection Filter for Protein Function
items.en_oneliner: This study finds that in structure-guided protein design, high structural confidence does not predict function, so it should not be the selection filter.

items.title: Can LLMs Write Backdoors? An Empirical Security Study of Weight-Space Programming
items.en_title: Can LLMs Write Backdoors? An Empirical Security Study of Weight-Space Programming
items.en_oneliner: This empirical study tests whether LLMs can plant backdoors directly in neural network weights via weight-space programming and assesses the security risk.

items.title: Diffusion Tree Sampling for Inference Time Adaptation of Crystal Generative Models
items.en_title: Diffusion Tree Sampling for Inference Time Adaptation of Crystal Generative Models
items.en_oneliner: This work lets crystal generative models adapt at inference time, turning a strong prior into more promising candidate structures.

items.title: A Synthetic Benchmark for Target-Centric Causal Discovery in Industrial Processes
items.en_title: A Synthetic Benchmark for Target-Centric Causal Discovery in Industrial Processes
items.en_oneliner: This synthetic benchmark tests whether causal discovery methods can find which recorded variables truly drive product quality, yield or energy use.

items.title: Rethinking Visual Reasoning in Text-to-Image Reward Modeling
items.en_title: Rethinking Visual Reasoning in Text-to-Image Reward Modeling
items.en_oneliner: This work argues text-to-image reward models need genuine visual reasoning to select better images at inference time and guide RL post-training.

items.title: CoTTAGE: An Explainable Judge for Text-to-Audio Generation
items.en_title: CoTTAGE: An Explainable Judge for Text-to-Audio Generation
items.en_oneliner: This explainable judge scores text-to-audio generation and explains its ratings, fixing metrics that give numbers without reasons.

items.title: GDP.xlsx: Benchmarking Frontier Models on Professional Workbooks
items.en_title: GDP.xlsx: Benchmarking Frontier Models on Professional Workbooks
items.en_oneliner: This benchmark tests frontier models on 70 realistic workplace requests across 13 domains, each graded against an expert rubric.

items.title: Multimodal Person Concept Model for Person Identification under Varying Observation Conditions
items.en_title: Multimodal Person Concept Model for Person Identification under Varying Observation Conditions
items.en_oneliner: This model lets service robots identify users from their preferences and past interactions under varying observation conditions.

items.title: Securing Multi-Agent Systems by Design
items.en_title: Securing Multi-Agent Systems by Design
items.en_oneliner: This work proposes building security into multi-agent system design rather than patching the decompose-delegate-aggregate pipeline afterward.

items.title: More Genes, Faster Inference: Efficient Large-Panel Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology
items.en_title: More Genes, Faster Inference: Efficient Large-Panel Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology
items.en_oneliner: This work infers spatially resolved gene expression profiles directly from histology images, covering more genes with faster inference.

items.title: Condensing Law of Security Information
items.en_title: Condensing Law of Security Information
items.en_oneliner: This study draws an analogy to scaling laws to explore how the generalization error of LLM security information changes with model size.

items.title: From Images to Grounded Edits: A Real-World Benchmark for Chinese Grammatical Error Correction in Handwritten Essays
items.en_title: From Images to Grounded Edits: A Real-World Benchmark for Chinese Grammatical Error Correction in Handwritten Essays
items.en_oneliner: This benchmark brings Chinese grammatical error correction to handwritten essay images, requiring edits grounded in the image rather than text-to-text conversion.

items.title: TelePhysica: Agentic Reconstruction of Physically Interactive Scenes
items.en_title: TelePhysica: Agentic Reconstruction of Physically Interactive Scenes
items.en_oneliner: This work lets agents reconstruct scenes with persistent 3D mechanical equilibrium, overcoming how image-to-video models entangle pixel synthesis with latent motion.

items.title: AG-JEPA: Anatomically Guided Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Neurodegenerative Representation Learning
items.en_title: AG-JEPA: Anatomically Guided Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Neurodegenerative Representation Learning
items.en_oneliner: This architecture uses anatomical guidance in brain MRI representation learning to capture early signs of Alzheimer's disease.

items.title: EcoVGGT: Pinned-Key Inference for Efficient and Streamable Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Long Videos
items.en_title: EcoVGGT: Pinned-Key Inference for Efficient and Streamable Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Long Videos
items.en_oneliner: This work uses pinned-key inference to make feed-forward 3D reconstruction from long videos faster and streamable.

items.title: An In-Silico Audit of Topographic Organization in a Multimodal Brain-Response Model
items.en_title: An In-Silico Audit of Topographic Organization in a Multimodal Brain-Response Model
items.en_oneliner: This audit examines whether the topographic organization inside TRIBE v2 holds up when it predicts fMRI responses across the cortex.

items.title: PUMA-Former: Uncertainty-Aware Agentic Computation Offloading in MEO-LEO Satellite Networks With Incomplete Information
items.en_title: PUMA-Former: Uncertainty-Aware Agentic Computation Offloading in MEO-LEO Satellite Networks With Incomplete Information
items.en_oneliner: This work coordinates computation offloading across moving satellite processors under incomplete information, with uncertainty awareness.

items.title: Personalization of Basic and Moral Values Guiding LLM-Controlled Assistant Robots
items.en_title: Personalization of Basic and Moral Values Guiding LLM-Controlled Assistant Robots
items.en_oneliner: This study explores whose values LLM-controlled assistant robots should follow as they enter everyday life, and how to personalize them.

items.title: RACE: Ranking-Uncertainty Aware Capacity-Adaptive Customization for Efficient Sequential Recommendation
items.en_title: RACE: Ranking-Uncertainty Aware Capacity-Adaptive Customization for Efficient Sequential Recommendation
items.en_oneliner: This work lets sequential recommendation models adapt their capacity to resource constraints for efficient real-time personalization.

items.title: From Bytes to Behavior: Request-Level Attribution from Live GPU Hidden States
items.en_title: From Bytes to Behavior: Request-Level Attribution from Live GPU Hidden States
items.en_oneliner: This work traces a machine learning behavior back to the request that caused it, using live GPU hidden states instead of static artifacts.

items.title: Vision-Language-Action Models: A Life-Cycle Survey of Design, Training and Deployment
items.en_title: Vision-Language-Action Models: A Life-Cycle Survey of Design, Training and Deployment
items.en_oneliner: This survey traces how vision-language-action models turn web-pretrained knowledge into robot actions, from design through deployment.

items.title: AI-Based Multi-View Echocardiographic Image Synthesis using Dynamic Shape Control
items.en_title: AI-Based Multi-View Echocardiographic Image Synthesis using Dynamic Shape Control
items.en_oneliner: This work synthesizes multi-view echocardiographic images with AI to ease the shortage of large, well-annotated datasets.

items.title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
items.en_title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
items.en_oneliner: This generalist agent framework targets long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments with an end-to-end architecture.

items.title: CoPre-MoE: Consolidating and Preserving MoE for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
items.en_title: CoPre-MoE: Consolidating and Preserving MoE for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
items.en_oneliner: This work lets multimodal LLMs sequentially acquire new capabilities without catastrophic forgetting, consolidating and preserving MoE experts.

items.title: From AI-Enabled Remote Patient Monitoring Toward Agentic Robotics: Embodiment, Governance, and Care Integration
items.en_title: From AI-Enabled Remote Patient Monitoring Toward Agentic Robotics: Embodiment, Governance, and Care Integration
items.en_oneliner: This work explores how AI-enabled remote patient monitoring evolves from passive data collection toward agentic systems that interpret patient states and coordinate care.

items.title: TradeGauntlet: Evaluating Compliance Controls for Autonomous Trading Agents
items.en_title: TradeGauntlet: Evaluating Compliance Controls for Autonomous Trading Agents
items.en_oneliner: This benchmark tests whether compliance controls for autonomous trading agents can block problematic orders without making legitimate tasks impractical.

items.title: Agentic AI for Discovering Fault-Tolerant Quantum Circuits
items.en_title: Agentic AI for Discovering Fault-Tolerant Quantum Circuits
items.en_oneliner: This work uses agentic AI to discover fault-tolerant quantum circuits, tackling the circuit-efficiency bottleneck on the way to practical quantum advantage.

items.title: WeightBench: Evaluating Language Models as Weight-Space Programmers
items.en_title: WeightBench: Evaluating Language Models as Weight-Space Programmers
items.en_oneliner: This benchmark tests whether language models can read and operate on other networks' parameters like programmers working with code.

items.title: Recursive Belief Vision Language Action Models
items.en_title: Recursive Belief Vision Language Action Models
items.en_oneliner: This work lets vision-language-action models handle long-horizon tasks under partial observability with recursive belief inference.

items.title: Multi-Environment POMDPs with Finite-Horizon Objectives
items.en_title: Multi-Environment POMDPs with Finite-Horizon Objectives
items.en_oneliner: This study examines how an agent with only partial observations can meet finite-horizon objectives in stochastic multi-environment settings.

items.title: Do LLMs Experience an Internal Polylogue? Investigating Reasoning through the Lens of Personas
items.en_title: Do LLMs Experience an Internal Polylogue? Investigating Reasoning through the Lens of Personas
items.en_oneliner: This study investigates whether LLM reasoning resembles an internal polylogue, using persona directions encoded in activation space as evidence.

items.title: ReForge: Keeping ABR Algorithms Never Finished with Verified Large Language Model Revisions
items.en_title: ReForge: Keeping ABR Algorithms Never Finished with Verified Large Language Model Revisions
items.en_oneliner: This work lets LLMs do in hours the ABR algorithm design that takes engineers months, with every revision verified.

items.title: From Regulation to Implementation: A Critical Evaluation of LLM-Assisted Regulatory Compliance in Industry
items.en_title: From Regulation to Implementation: A Critical Evaluation of LLM-Assisted Regulatory Compliance in Industry
items.en_oneliner: This critical evaluation examines how LLM-assisted regulatory compliance actually lands in industry under EU sustainability and privacy rules.

items.title: AI Agents Push Humans Out of the Loop
items.en_title: AI Agents Push Humans Out of the Loop
items.en_oneliner: This study argues that as AI agents gain autonomy, human oversight is often pushed aside and 'human in the loop' becomes nominal.

items.title: Efficient Test-Time Adaptation through Human-Agent Interaction
items.en_title: Efficient Test-Time Adaptation through Human-Agent Interaction
items.en_oneliner: This work lets agents adapt at test time through interaction with humans, bridging the gap between population-trained capabilities and individual needs.

items.title: When to Rethink: Learning Multi-Perspective Self-Verification for Vision-Language Models
items.en_title: When to Rethink: Learning Multi-Perspective Self-Verification for Vision-Language Models
items.en_oneliner: This work teaches vision-language models to self-verify from multiple perspectives and know when to rethink.

items.title: Self-Building Labs
items.en_title: Self-Building Labs
items.en_oneliner: This work explores how AI agents can take self-driving laboratories from automating experiments to building the labs themselves.

items.title: TimesJev: Thinking Fast on Time Series with System 1 Sufficiency
items.en_title: TimesJev: Thinking Fast on Time Series with System 1 Sufficiency
items.en_oneliner: This work lets LLMs reason over time series with fast System 1-style thinking instead of slow deliberation every time.

items.title: Can LLMs Improve Their Own Harness? A Controlled Study on ARC-AGI-3
items.en_title: Can LLMs Improve Their Own Harness? A Controlled Study on ARC-AGI-3
items.en_oneliner: This controlled study tests whether a generally intelligent system can acquire new skills efficiently without humans redesigning its software scaffold.

items.title: One Offset, Two Directions: Baseline Adjustment via Subgroup Offsets
items.en_title: One Offset, Two Directions: Baseline Adjustment via Subgroup Offsets
items.en_oneliner: This work fixes a practical flaw in GRPO's within-group mean baseline by adjusting it with subgroup offsets.

items.title: AttentionSwitch: Jailbreak Defense for LLMs via Joint Learning of Sparse Attention-Head Selection and Scaling
items.en_title: AttentionSwitch: Jailbreak Defense for LLMs via Joint Learning of Sparse Attention-Head Selection and Scaling
items.en_oneliner: This work defends LLMs against jailbreak attacks by jointly learning which attention heads to select and how to scale them.

items.title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
items.en_title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
items.en_oneliner: Drawing on metacognition, this architecture steers what to study next from the scientific understanding it has already built up, speeding discovery along.

items.title: AutoManifold: Agentic Design of Data Visualisation Algorithms via Manifold Embedding
items.en_title: AutoManifold: Agentic Design of Data Visualisation Algorithms via Manifold Embedding
items.en_oneliner: This work lets agents automatically design manifold-embedding visualisation algorithms instead of relying on a handful of hand-designed classics.

items.title: Ballad: Bandit-Based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery
items.en_title: Ballad: Bandit-Based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery
items.en_oneliner: Ballad uses bandit algorithms to route LLM calls, letting automated heuristic discovery systems find better heuristics on their own through iteration.

items.title: Astraios: Parameter-Efficient Instruction Tuning Code Large Language Models
items.en_title: Astraios: Parameter-Efficient Instruction Tuning Code Large Language Models
items.en_oneliner: Astraios replaces full-parameter fine-tuning with parameter-efficient methods, sharply cutting the cost of instruction-tuning code LLMs.

items.title: LEGAL-UQA: Testing Constitutional Question-Answering Systems for Urdu Speakers with a Parallel English-Urdu Benchmark
items.en_title: LEGAL-UQA: Testing Constitutional Question-Answering Systems for Urdu Speakers with a Parallel English-Urdu Benchmark
items.en_oneliner: LEGAL-UQA provides a parallel English-Urdu benchmark for testing whether legal information assistants reliably help Urdu speakers understand their constitutional rights.

items.title: Graph Your Own Prompt
items.en_title: Graph Your Own Prompt
items.en_oneliner: This work proposes graph consistency regularization, injecting relational graph structures derived from model predictions into prompts to make prompt optimization more stable and reliable.

items.title: NEAT: Neighborhood-Guided, Efficient, Autoregressive Set Transformer for 3D Molecular Generation
items.en_title: NEAT: Neighborhood-Guided, Efficient, Autoregressive Set Transformer for 3D Molecular Generation
items.en_oneliner: NEAT uses a neighborhood-guided autoregressive Transformer to generate 3D molecules more efficiently than diffusion and flow models, offering a faster generative route for drug design.

items.title: Tracing 3D Anatomy in 2D Strokes: Can Projection-Derived Masks Replace 3D Segmentation for Cervical Spine Fracture Recognition?
items.en_title: Tracing 3D Anatomy in 2D Strokes: Can Projection-Derived Masks Replace 3D Segmentation for Cervical Spine Fracture Recognition?
items.en_oneliner: This study tests whether projection-derived masks can replace full 3D segmentation for cervical spine fracture recognition, aiming to make automatic CT interpretation faster and cheaper.

items.title: ScrapeGraphAI-100k: Dataset for Schema-Constrained LLM Generation
items.en_title: ScrapeGraphAI-100k: Dataset for Schema-Constrained LLM Generation
items.en_oneliner: Built from 100,000 examples, the dataset teaches LLMs to emit output matching a given JSON schema — groundwork for tool calls, structured extraction, and knowledge-base building.

items.title: ViroGym: Realistic Large-Scale Benchmarks for Evaluating Viral Proteins
items.en_title: ViroGym: Realistic Large-Scale Benchmarks for Evaluating Viral Proteins
items.en_oneliner: ViroGym gives protein language models a realistic large-scale benchmark to systematically test their zero-shot prediction of viral protein mutation effects.

items.title: CPGRec+: A Balance-oriented Framework for Personalized Video Game Recommendations
items.en_title: CPGRec+: A Balance-oriented Framework for Personalized Video Game Recommendations
items.en_oneliner: CPGRec+ balances personalization and diversity for the fast-changing game industry, making game recommendations better matched to players' tastes.

items.title: Time series causal discovery with variable lags
items.en_title: Time series causal discovery with variable lags
items.en_oneliner: This work uses causal Bayesian networks to handle problems that evolve over time, allowing variable lags between variables so time-series causal discovery fits reality better.

items.title: TransitLM: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Map-Free Transit Route Generation
items.en_title: TransitLM: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Map-Free Transit Route Generation
items.en_oneliner: TransitLM provides a large-scale dataset and benchmark so models can plan public transit routes without structured map infrastructure.

items.title: Larch: Learned Query Optimization for Semantic Predicates
items.en_title: Larch: Learned Query Optimization for Semantic Predicates
items.en_oneliner: As LLMs bring semantic operators into databases, Larch uses learned optimization to speed up analytical queries with semantic predicates over unstructured data.

items.title: URSA: Chemistry-Aware Benchmark for Utilitarian Retrosynthesis Assessment
items.en_title: URSA: Chemistry-Aware Benchmark for Utilitarian Retrosynthesis Assessment
items.en_oneliner: URSA provides a chemistry-aware benchmark for evaluating synthesis planning that finds reaction pathways for target molecules, serving retrosynthesis in drug discovery.

items.title: When Does On-Policy Interaction Help? Representational Tradeoffs in Value-Based Imitation Learning
items.en_title: When Does On-Policy Interaction Help? Representational Tradeoffs in Value-Based Imitation Learning
items.en_oneliner: This study analyses when interacting with the environment online actually helps in value-based imitation learning, and the representational tradeoffs behind it.

items.title: From Data to Program: Fast & Direct Generative Program Inference from Empirical Data
items.en_title: From Data to Program: Fast & Direct Generative Program Inference from Empirical Data
items.en_oneliner: PRODiGI is a pretrained model that infers the program generating the data directly from a finite set of samples, skipping dataset-specific model fitting.

items.title: Inject a Turn, Not a Token: Learning Where to Redirect LLM Reasoning for Self-Correction
items.en_title: Inject a Turn, Not a Token: Learning Where to Redirect LLM Reasoning for Self-Correction
items.en_oneliner: Instead of fine-tuning, this work learns where in a reasoning trace to intervene and redirect, so LLMs can more reliably spot and correct their own errors.

items.title: Brain2Vec: A Self-Supervised 3D Foundation Model for Structural Brain MRI
items.en_title: Brain2Vec: A Self-Supervised 3D Foundation Model for Structural Brain MRI
items.en_oneliner: Brain2Vec is a self-supervised 3D foundation model that lets diverse structural brain MRI tasks run without end-to-end retraining, lowering the training barrier for medical imaging.

items.title: EmbodiExp: Compositional Experience Transfer for Embodied Agents
items.en_title: EmbodiExp: Compositional Experience Transfer for Embodied Agents
items.en_oneliner: EmbodiExp lets embodied agents compose experience from past tasks and transfer it to new ones, keeping that experience applicable even when conditions change.

items.title: An Axiomatic Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
items.en_title: An Axiomatic Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
items.en_oneliner: This work builds an axiomatic framework for reinforcement learning in open multi-agent systems where only some agents are controllable, covering real domains like smart grids.

items.title: NaijaFacts: A Framework for Disentangling Language from Knowledge in Facts about Nigeria
items.en_title: NaijaFacts: A Framework for Disentangling Language from Knowledge in Facts about Nigeria
items.en_oneliner: NaijaFacts addresses the flaw that multilingual benchmarks for African languages mostly test translation rather than local knowledge, specifically testing models' grasp of facts about Nigeria.

items.title: Deletion Sensitivity Is a Property of the Model: A Three-Condition Measurement over 72 Valid Experimental Cells
items.en_title: Deletion Sensitivity Is a Property of the Model: A Three-Condition Measurement over 72 Valid Experimental Cells
items.en_oneliner: This study measures how model performance changes when reasoning traces are deleted in multi-turn tool sessions, showing deletion sensitivity is a property of the model itself.

items.title: ForeSpark: Joint Draft and Verification Budget Scheduling for Parallel Speculative Decoding
items.en_title: ForeSpark: Joint Draft and Verification Budget Scheduling for Parallel Speculative Decoding
items.en_oneliner: ForeSpark jointly schedules draft and verification budgets for parallel drafters, speeding up LLM decoding when a whole block of draft tokens is proposed in one forward pass.

items.title: TransGHOST: Real-Time, Synthesis-Free Reconstruction of Instrument-Occluded Regions in Ophthalmic Microsurgery
items.en_title: TransGHOST: Real-Time, Synthesis-Free Reconstruction of Instrument-Occluded Regions in Ophthalmic Microsurgery
items.en_oneliner: TransGHOST reconstructs instrument-occluded regions in ophthalmic microsurgery in real time without synthesized imagery, giving surgeons a more complete intraoperative view.

items.title: CARE-Drive: Coupled Alternating Refinement for Ego-trajectories
items.en_title: CARE-Drive: Coupled Alternating Refinement for Ego-trajectories
items.en_oneliner: CARE-Drive improves ego-trajectory planning in end-to-end autonomous driving with coupled alternating refinement for vision-language-action models.

items.title: Indic-Task Gains and Regressions after Reinforcement Learning
items.en_title: Indic-Task Gains and Regressions after Reinforcement Learning
items.en_oneliner: The researchers apply GRPO reinforcement learning to a 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model in four settings, tracking which abilities on Indic-language tasks get better and which get worse.

items.title: HyBridge: Bridge-Guided Self-Supervised Hyperbolic Hypergraph Representation Learning
items.en_title: HyBridge: Bridge-Guided Self-Supervised Hyperbolic Hypergraph Representation Learning
items.en_oneliner: HyBridge learns hyperbolic representations of hypergraphs with bridge-guided self-supervision, capturing groupwise relationships among nodes and tree-like structures.

items.title: LoRAWeaver: Directional Adapter Routing in LoRA Representation Space
items.en_title: LoRAWeaver: Directional Adapter Routing in LoRA Representation Space
items.en_oneliner: LoRAWeaver routes adapters by direction inside LoRA representation space, letting a large model keep each task's ability intact across repeated low-cost fine-tuning rounds.

items.title: Tabular Population Priors as Structured Retrieval for EHR Medication Set Prediction
items.en_title: Tabular Population Priors as Structured Retrieval for EHR Medication Set Prediction
items.en_oneliner: This study turns population-level medication statistics into a structured retrieval signal to improve medication-set prediction from electronic health records.

items.title: Astrocyte Biocomputing: Astrocytic Contributions to Neural Network Computation
items.en_title: Astrocyte Biocomputing: Astrocytic Contributions to Neural Network Computation
items.en_oneliner: Drawing inspiration from astrocytes, this paper explores how these conductor-like brain cells modulate neural network computation and what they suggest for new computing architectures.

items.title: AI-Voyager: A Public-Interest System for Human-AI Civic Reasoning to Contest and Shape the Rules That Govern AI
items.en_title: AI-Voyager: A Public-Interest System for Human-AI Civic Reasoning to Contest and Shape the Rules That Govern AI
items.en_oneliner: AI-Voyager is a public-interest system that helps ordinary people take part in debates over AI rules, giving those affected by them a voice in defining automated decisions and harms.

items.title: When Does Less Information Pay? An Exact Finite Atlas of Representation, Payoff, and Cost
items.en_title: When Does Less Information Pay? An Exact Finite Atlas of Representation, Payoff, and Cost
items.en_oneliner: Using an exact finite atlas, this paper shows that a representation keeping less information can sometimes deliver better task payoff, challenging the intuition that more information is always better.

items.title: Safety Side Effects of Preventative Persona Steering: An Empirical Audit
items.en_title: Safety Side Effects of Preventative Persona Steering: An Empirical Audit
items.en_oneliner: This audit finds that steering a model in advance to suppress behaviors like sycophancy and hallucination can trigger unexpected safety side effects, warning developers to use such interventions carefully.

items.title: An AI-enabled high-resolution chlorophyll-a forecasting model that outperforms the operational global biogeochemical system
items.en_title: An AI-enabled high-resolution chlorophyll-a forecasting model that outperforms the operational global biogeochemical system
items.en_oneliner: This AI model forecasts surface chlorophyll-a distribution at higher resolution and outperforms the operational global biogeochemical system in short-term predictions.

items.title: Cross-Linguistic Acoustic Biomarkers of Cognitive Impairment Across Interactive and Single-Speaker Speech Tasks
items.en_title: Cross-Linguistic Acoustic Biomarkers of Cognitive Impairment Across Interactive and Single-Speaker Speech Tasks
items.en_oneliner: This study extracts acoustic features from multilingual speech to screen for cognitive impairment across conversational and single-speaker tasks, aiming to make dementia screening fairer and more scalable.

items.title: Federated Soft Poly-Level Learning Over a Distributed Network with Guaranteed Convergence
items.en_title: Federated Soft Poly-Level Learning Over a Distributed Network with Guaranteed Convergence
items.en_oneliner: This paper proposes a federated multi-level learning method for distributed networks with guaranteed convergence, so multi-level optimization problems like bilevel optimization can be solved reliably in decentralized settings.

items.title: A Spectral Framework for Universal Proxy Regularization in Model Merging
items.en_title: A Spectral Framework for Universal Proxy Regularization in Model Merging
items.en_oneliner: Model merging often degrades performance through parameter interference, and this study offers a spectral framework for universal proxy regularization that keeps merged multi-task models less affected by it.

items.title: Knowledge After Collapse: Context and Wording Shape Factual Accessibility in Language Models
items.en_title: Knowledge After Collapse: Context and Wording Shape Factual Accessibility in Language Models
items.en_oneliner: After a language model accepts a false correction, the context and wording of the conversation determine whether it can still retrieve the right fact, and this paper systematically reveals that knowledge-collapse phenomenon.

items.title: TReC: Evaluating Move-Induced State Changes in Instruction-Conditioned Go
items.en_title: TReC: Evaluating Move-Induced State Changes in Instruction-Conditioned Go
items.en_oneliner: Instead of only measuring how far a Go model's move lands from the expert's, TReC evaluates how each move changes the board state, giving a sharper measure of the model's understanding.

items.title: Can Agents Keep Up with Time? An Empirical Analysis of Temporal Adaptation After a Conversational Hiatus
items.en_title: Can Agents Keep Up with Time? An Empirical Analysis of Temporal Adaptation After a Conversational Hiatus
items.en_oneliner: When a long-horizon assistant returns after a conversational hiatus, this paper empirically tests whether it can correctly handle the passage of time.

items.title: Causally Constrained and Uncertainty-Aware Cardiopulmonary Risk Prediction
items.en_title: Causally Constrained and Uncertainty-Aware Cardiopulmonary Risk Prediction
items.en_oneliner: This study uses routine chest CT scans to jointly assess lung cancer and cardiovascular risk, adding uncertainty estimates to support clinical judgment.

items.title: AI-aided Decision-Making in Education - Uncertainty, Explainability, and Human Responsibility
items.en_title: AI-aided Decision-Making in Education - Uncertainty, Explainability, and Human Responsibility
items.en_oneliner: This paper discusses how uncertainty, explainability and human responsibility should be handled as AI enters educational decision-making.

items.title: FlexCast: Flexible Context Learning for Time Series Foundation Models
items.en_title: FlexCast: Flexible Context Learning for Time Series Foundation Models
items.en_oneliner: This work disentangles context conditioning from prediction in time series foundation models so they can adapt flexibly to different history lengths.

items.title: OmniScore-Bench: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Musical Score Reading
items.en_title: OmniScore-Bench: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Musical Score Reading
items.en_oneliner: This benchmark tests whether vision-language models can read musical notation, recover its structure and interpret it musically.

items.title: SWIFT: Sample-Wise Instance Fine-Tuning of Time-Series Foundation Models for Forecasting
items.en_title: SWIFT: Sample-Wise Instance Fine-Tuning of Time-Series Foundation Models for Forecasting
items.en_oneliner: This work proposes sample-wise fine-tuning for time series foundation models, making few-shot forecasting adapt faster and more accurately.

items.title: RecMem: Recurrent Memory Compression for Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation
items.en_title: RecMem: Recurrent Memory Compression for Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation
items.en_oneliner: This work compresses long interaction histories with recurrent memory so generative recommenders can use long context without linearly growing cost.

items.title: Tracing Actual Causes with Counterfactual Witness Maps
items.en_title: Tracing Actual Causes with Counterfactual Witness Maps
items.en_oneliner: This work uses counterfactual witness maps to formally trace which event in a specific situation actually caused an outcome.

items.title: Measured from the feed: the unsustainable growth of AI video generation
items.en_title: Measured from the feed: the unsustainable growth of AI video generation
items.en_oneliner: This study measures the environmental cost of commercial text-to-video generation, noting providers rarely disclose it while growth itself looks unsustainable.

items.title: Toward Interference-Agnostic RF Source Separation
items.en_title: Toward Interference-Agnostic RF Source Separation
items.en_oneliner: This work moves RF signal separation toward general separators that no longer need a dedicated model per interference type.

items.title: Interactive deep-learning based interface for brain tumour segmentation
items.en_title: Interactive deep-learning based interface for brain tumour segmentation
items.en_oneliner: This interactive interface helps clinicians segment brain tumors with deep-learning assistance, serving both surgery and radiotherapy planning.

items.title: LACCO: Local Accumulation with Computation--Communication Overlap
items.en_title: LACCO: Local Accumulation with Computation--Communication Overlap
items.en_oneliner: This work cuts synchronization overhead when training language models over low-bandwidth networks by overlapping local computation with communication.

items.title: Understanding the limits of snapshot-based fault diagnosis in distribution networks
items.en_title: Understanding the limits of snapshot-based fault diagnosis in distribution networks
items.en_oneliner: The study looks at how inverter connections weaken fault currents and why diagnosing faults from a single snapshot of voltage phasors stops working.

items.title: Two-Clustering Regime of Token Dynamics in Causal Attention
items.en_title: Two-Clustering Regime of Token Dynamics in Causal Attention
items.en_oneliner: This study partially resolves and extends a conjecture on token clustering under causal attention masking, revealing how the dynamics evolve over time.

items.title: Optimizing Drilling Trajectories in Multi-Material Structures Using Quantum Annealers
items.en_title: Optimizing Drilling Trajectories in Multi-Material Structures Using Quantum Annealers
items.en_oneliner: The authors plan drilling paths through multi-material structures with a quantum-hybrid optimizer, aiming to cut machining costs.

items.title: Probabilities of Causation in Nondeterministic Causal Models
items.en_title: Probabilities of Causation in Nondeterministic Causal Models
items.en_oneliner: This study examines how to define and compute probabilities of causation when causal mechanisms remain intrinsically stochastic.

items.title: Causal AI-Driven Secure mmWave Beam Alignment with Defensive Variational Autoencoders
items.en_title: Causal AI-Driven Secure mmWave Beam Alignment with Defensive Variational Autoencoders
items.en_oneliner: This work uses causal AI and defensive variational autoencoders to make mmWave beam alignment both efficient and resistant to attacks.

items.title: VLAN: Vision-Language Accessible Navigation
items.en_title: VLAN: Vision-Language Accessible Navigation
items.en_oneliner: This work designs accessible navigation conditioned on each user's mobility, since the same path can be walkable for one person and blocked for another.

items.title: Towards Explainable Sleep Stage Classification using Single-Channel Electroencephalogram
items.en_title: Towards Explainable Sleep Stage Classification using Single-Channel Electroencephalogram
items.en_oneliner: This work makes automated sleep staging from single-channel EEG interpretable enough for clinical adoption.

items.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Sequence Models for Sample-Efficient Energy Regression in Simulated Calorimeter Showers
items.en_title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Sequence Models for Sample-Efficient Energy Regression in Simulated Calorimeter Showers
items.en_oneliner: This work uses hybrid quantum-classical sequence models to reconstruct energy from calorimeter data with better sample efficiency.

items.title: Enumerating Posterior-Supported Priors: First-Order Error of Finite-Integral Cross-Categorical Measurement Morphisms
items.en_title: Enumerating Posterior-Supported Priors: First-Order Error of Finite-Integral Cross-Categorical Measurement Morphisms
items.en_oneliner: This study analyzes the error component that standard measure conventions ignore in generative modeling and characterizes its first-order effect.

items.title: WETW: Learning Pair-Specific Weighted Euclidean Distances for Efficient DTW Search
items.en_title: WETW: Learning Pair-Specific Weighted Euclidean Distances for Efficient DTW Search
items.en_oneliner: This work learns pair-specific weighted distances for dynamic time warping search, avoiding quadratic cost and speeding up time series similarity search.

items.title: Racing the Clock: Teaching VLNs Budget-Conditioned Object Search
items.en_title: Racing the Clock: Teaching VLNs Budget-Conditioned Object Search
items.en_oneliner: This work teaches vision-language navigation agents to adjust their search strategy to the remaining time budget, sprinting when the clock is short.

items.title: Use-case-driven ontology modeling with the NeOn methodology for ambient assisted living
items.en_title: Use-case-driven ontology modeling with the NeOn methodology for ambient assisted living
items.en_oneliner: This work applies the NeOn methodology to model ontologies for smart homes and ambient assisted living, driven by real use cases.

items.title: Do Mixture-of-Experts Routers Benefit from Ensembling?
items.en_title: Do Mixture-of-Experts Routers Benefit from Ensembling?
items.en_oneliner: This study tests whether ensembling mixture-of-experts routers genuinely improves performance or merely repeats single-network gains.

items.title: Adversarial Tracking: Attacks on Image Sensors for Object Tracking in Autonomous Vehicles
items.en_title: Adversarial Tracking: Attacks on Image Sensors for Object Tracking in Autonomous Vehicles
items.en_oneliner: This study shows how attacks on image sensors can disrupt object tracking in autonomous vehicles, exposing a security gap in perception.

items.title: GraphScent: Calibrating Directional Relevance Signals for Bounded-Context Code Localization
items.en_title: GraphScent: Calibrating Directional Relevance Signals for Bounded-Context Code Localization
items.en_oneliner: This work calibrates directional relevance signals so code localization works within bounded context when running open-weight models on a single consumer GPU.

items.title: X-Nav Technical Report: Real-World Long-Horizon Indoor-to-Outdoor Navigation on a Humanoid Robot
items.en_title: X-Nav Technical Report: Real-World Long-Horizon Indoor-to-Outdoor Navigation on a Humanoid Robot
items.en_oneliner: This technical report describes how a humanoid robot completes long-horizon indoor-to-outdoor navigation from a single instruction.

items.title: Training-Free Acceleration of Multi-View 3D Transformers via Regime-Aware Attention Approximation
items.en_title: Training-Free Acceleration of Multi-View 3D Transformers via Regime-Aware Attention Approximation
items.en_oneliner: This work accelerates multi-view 3D transformers without training, speeding up scene reconstruction from unposed images.

items.title: Binarization as an Attack Surface in Weightless Neural Networks
items.en_title: Binarization as an Attack Surface in Weightless Neural Networks
items.en_oneliner: This study reveals that binarizing inputs in weightless neural networks itself creates an attack surface that can be exploited.

items.title: Imitation Policies Learn a Proprioceptive Anchor: A Predictive Law for Perception Noise and Its Closed Loop Cost
items.en_title: Imitation Policies Learn a Proprioceptive Anchor: A Predictive Law for Perception Noise and Its Closed Loop Cost
items.en_oneliner: This study reveals how robot imitation policies learn to discount noisy position readings and quantifies the closed-loop cost of doing so.

items.title: Creative Product Design under Brand Image Constraints
items.en_title: Creative Product Design under Brand Image Constraints
items.en_oneliner: This work lets AI explore creative product visuals while satisfying implicit constraints such as brand image.

items.title: Activation Steering the Nan-Shan in Typhoon
items.en_title: Activation Steering the Nan-Shan in Typhoon
items.en_oneliner: This art experiment uses activation steering to guide a model through steering the Nan-Shan in Conrad's novella Typhoon.

items.title: Towards Seconds-level Video Representation: Quadratically Gated Feature Grid with Adaptive, Prediction-free Sampling
items.en_title: Towards Seconds-level Video Representation: Quadratically Gated Feature Grid with Adaptive, Prediction-free Sampling
items.en_oneliner: This work brings implicit neural video representation construction down to seconds, crossing the practical threshold for industrial use.

items.title: Can Large Language Models Optimize Pretrained Neural Network Weights? A Multi-Phase Empirical Evaluation of Gradient-Free Editing in YOLO26 Object Detection
items.en_title: Can Large Language Models Optimize Pretrained Neural Network Weights? A Multi-Phase Empirical Evaluation of Gradient-Free Editing in YOLO26 Object Detection
items.en_oneliner: This multi-phase empirical study tests whether LLMs can directly edit YOLO26 detector weights without gradients and how well it generalizes.

items.title: V-JEPA-LM: Video-Language Models That Read Dynamics Beyond Static, Text-Aligned Representations
items.en_title: V-JEPA-LM: Video-Language Models That Read Dynamics Beyond Static, Text-Aligned Representations
items.en_oneliner: This video-language model reads dynamics — direction, speed, order and state changes — instead of relying on static, text-aligned representations.

items.title: Tracing Uncertainties of Extreme El Ni\~{n}o Prediction to Mesoscale Ocean Currents
items.en_title: Tracing Uncertainties of Extreme El Ni\~{n}o Prediction to Mesoscale Ocean Currents
items.en_oneliner: This study traces uncertainty in extreme El Niño prediction to mesoscale ocean currents rather than large-scale errors in model initial conditions.

items.title: Active Learning of Temporal Specifications through Distinguishing Queries
items.en_title: Active Learning of Temporal Specifications through Distinguishing Queries
items.en_oneliner: This work uses distinguishing queries in active learning to help write temporal specifications that actually capture the intended behavior.

items.title: UltraBERT-JEV: Encoder models for System One Applications
items.en_title: UltraBERT-JEV: Encoder models for System One Applications
items.en_oneliner: This technical report pits several encoder recipes against each other to see which picks the right answer fastest in one forward pass, with no text generated.

items.title: DySENSE: Dynamic Spatiotemporal ENergy Synthesis and Emulation with Satellite Imagery
items.en_title: DySENSE: Dynamic Spatiotemporal ENergy Synthesis and Emulation with Satellite Imagery
items.en_oneliner: This work dynamically synthesizes city energy use from satellite imagery to support urban energy planning and emissions analysis.

items.title: From Local Prediction Error to Final Outputs: A Theory of Expert Sharing in Multi-Step Reasoning
items.en_title: From Local Prediction Error to Final Outputs: A Theory of Expert Sharing in Multi-Step Reasoning
items.en_oneliner: This theoretical work explains how sharing experts across layers and steps in MoE models lets local errors shape final outputs.

items.title: Photogrammetric 3D Model-Based Animal Behavior Classification
items.en_title: Photogrammetric 3D Model-Based Animal Behavior Classification
items.en_oneliner: This work reconstructs 3D body and object models first, then classifies animal behavior, instead of estimating it end-to-end from video.

items.title: RL$^{\mathrm{RT}}$: On-Device Reinforcement Learning Runtime
items.en_title: RL$^{\mathrm{RT}}$: On-Device Reinforcement Learning Runtime
items.en_oneliner: This on-device RL runtime puts a periodic actor and a learner on a single embedded GPU, balancing their workloads so they share the hardware smoothly.

items.title: Interpretable weight-space programming builds transparent transformers and brain encoding models
items.en_title: Interpretable weight-space programming builds transparent transformers and brain encoding models
items.en_oneliner: This work uses interpretable weight-space programming to build transparent transformers that serve scientific explanation, not just prediction.

items.title: T2ST: Data-Efficient Spatio-Temporal Foundation Models via Temporal Data and Knowledge Transfer
items.en_title: T2ST: Data-Efficient Spatio-Temporal Foundation Models via Temporal Data and Knowledge Transfer
items.en_oneliner: This work uses temporal data and knowledge transfer to cut spatio-temporal foundation models' appetite for large synchronized corpora.

items.title: From Pen-and-Paper to Machine-Checked Proofs: Lean for System Identification
items.en_title: From Pen-and-Paper to Machine-Checked Proofs: Lean for System Identification
items.en_oneliner: This work moves long, intricate proofs in system identification into machine-checked form with Lean.

items.title: ParetoM$^3$: Learning on the Pareto Set under Preference Guidance via Min-Max-Min Optimization
items.en_title: ParetoM$^3$: Learning on the Pareto Set under Preference Guidance via Min-Max-Min Optimization
items.en_oneliner: This work selects desirable trade-offs from the Pareto set under preference guidance when objectives conflict.

items.title: Right Token, Right Time: From Per-Token Gating to Trajectory-Aware Activation Steering
items.en_title: Right Token, Right Time: From Per-Token Gating to Trajectory-Aware Activation Steering
items.en_oneliner: This work upgrades activation steering from per-token gating to trajectory awareness, aligning behavioral control with the whole generation path.

items.title: AI for Parameter Selection in Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization
items.en_title: AI for Parameter Selection in Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization
items.en_oneliner: This work uses AI to select parameters for sample-based quantum diagonalization, where accuracy and runtime depend heavily on those choices.

items.title: Between Obligations and Evidence: A Participatory Study of Translating the EU AI Act into Technical Requirements
items.en_title: Between Obligations and Evidence: A Participatory Study of Translating the EU AI Act into Technical Requirements
items.en_oneliner: This participatory study explores how contextual choices shape the translation of EU AI Act requirements for high-risk systems into technical practice.

items.title: Interactive Program Induction with Language Model Priors
items.en_title: Interactive Program Induction with Language Model Priors
items.en_oneliner: This work lets a learner recover a program from a few input-output examples, guided interactively by language model priors.

items.title: MeReader: An Offline, Privacy-Preserving, Progress-Aware AI Assistant for Narrative eBook Reading
items.en_title: MeReader: An Offline, Privacy-Preserving, Progress-Aware AI Assistant for Narrative eBook Reading
items.en_oneliner: This AI assistant reads narrative eBooks offline with privacy protection, tracking reading progress as a contextual companion.

items.title: Elliptic Sampling: Optimal Interpolant Schedules for Gaussians and Beyond
items.en_title: Elliptic Sampling: Optimal Interpolant Schedules for Gaussians and Beyond
items.en_oneliner: This work finds optimal interpolant schedules for stochastic-interpolant generative modeling, bridging initial and target distributions.

items.title: Evaluating Chain-of-Thought Reasoning through Reusability and Verifiability
items.en_title: Evaluating Chain-of-Thought Reasoning through Reusability and Verifiability
items.en_oneliner: This study evaluates chain-of-thought reasoning through reusability and verifiability, since AI applications often chain models where one output feeds the next.

items.title: Certified Policy Optimisation for Nested Causal Bandits via PAC-Bayes Risk
items.en_title: Certified Policy Optimisation for Nested Causal Bandits via PAC-Bayes Risk
items.en_oneliner: This work provides certified policy optimization for nested causal bandits, where strategic decisions causally shape the context of later tactical choices.

items.title: MeanFlowAdvantage: Stable Reward Fine-Tuning for Few-Step Average-Velocity Generators
items.en_title: MeanFlowAdvantage: Stable Reward Fine-Tuning for Few-Step Average-Velocity Generators
items.en_oneliner: This work fixes the mismatch between reward fine-tuning and the average-velocity representation in few-step MeanFlow generation, stabilizing the tuning.

items.title: Proof-Grounded Patient-Specific Clinical Explanations from Knowledge-Graph Reasoning
items.en_title: Proof-Grounded Patient-Specific Clinical Explanations from Knowledge-Graph Reasoning
items.en_oneliner: The work makes clinical decision support auditable at every step — what is observed, what encoded knowledge says, and what is concluded and recommended.

items.title: TorchTPU - A Hybrid Eager/Compiled Architecture for Native PyTorch Execution on TPU
items.en_title: TorchTPU - A Hybrid Eager/Compiled Architecture for Native PyTorch Execution on TPU
items.en_oneliner: This open-source collaboration between Google and Meta brings a native PyTorch backend to TPUs, combining eager and compiled execution.

items.title: FlashRT-PAI: Fast Kernels Are Not Fast Pipelines for Physical AI
items.en_title: FlashRT-PAI: Fast Kernels Are Not Fast Pipelines for Physical AI
items.en_oneliner: This work shows that in physical AI systems, fast kernels do not mean fast pipelines, and the bottleneck lies elsewhere.

items.title: Pluralistic Alignment in Large Language Models: Objectives, Human References, and Preference Representations
items.en_title: Pluralistic Alignment in Large Language Models: Objectives, Human References, and Preference Representations
items.en_oneliner: Rather than squeezing diverse human preferences into one target, alignment should keep meaningful differences intact, the work argues.

items.title: Function-Preserving Audits of Visual Weight Readers
items.en_title: Function-Preserving Audits of Visual Weight Readers
items.en_oneliner: Because the same image can be encoded with different weights, auditing a reader has to verify it relies on function rather than a coincidence of parameters, the study notes.

items.title: MIGRO: A Decoupled and Portable Long-Term Memory System for Language Models
items.en_title: MIGRO: A Decoupled and Portable Long-Term Memory System for Language Models
items.en_oneliner: MIGRO decouples observations, revisions, and context accumulated from user interaction from the model itself, so long-term memory survives model upgrades.

items.title: Small Heads, Strong Decisions: A Controlled Study of Typed-Decision Models
items.en_title: Small Heads, Strong Decisions: A Controlled Study of Typed-Decision Models
items.en_oneliner: This controlled study examines typed-decision models like TypeSafe's Jev, testing how small decision heads produce calibrated, typed decisions.

items.title: Fake News Detectors are Biased against Texts Generated by Large Language Models
items.en_title: Fake News Detectors are Biased against Texts Generated by Large Language Models
items.en_oneliner: The study finds fake-news detectors systematically misclassify LLM-generated text as fake news, exposing a bias in current detection methods against machine-generated content.

items.title: Benign Overfitting for Regression with Trained Two-Layer ReLU Networks
items.en_title: Benign Overfitting for Regression with Trained Two-Layer ReLU Networks
items.en_oneliner: This study analyses why two-layer ReLU networks trained by gradient descent can overfit regression tasks without harming generalization, revealing the conditions for benign overfitting.

items.title: AbFlowNet: Optimizing Antibody-Antigen Binding Energy via Diffusion-GFlowNet Fusion
items.en_title: AbFlowNet: Optimizing Antibody-Antigen Binding Energy via Diffusion-GFlowNet Fusion
items.en_oneliner: AbFlowNet combines diffusion models with GFlowNet to optimize antibody complementarity-determining regions so designed antibodies bind their target antigens more tightly.

items.title: Chi-Square Wavelet Graph Neural Networks for Heterogeneous Graph Anomaly Detection
items.en_title: Chi-Square Wavelet Graph Neural Networks for Heterogeneous Graph Anomaly Detection
items.en_oneliner: This work uses chi-square wavelet graph neural networks to handle node and edge diversity in heterogeneous graphs, making graph anomaly detection more accurate in complex networks.

items.title: BigCodeArena: Unveiling More Reliable Human Preferences in Code Generation via Execution
items.en_title: BigCodeArena: Unveiling More Reliable Human Preferences in Code Generation via Execution
items.en_oneliner: BigCodeArena borrows the crowdsourced evaluation idea of Chatbot Arena and uses actual execution results to judge code generation quality, making human-preference evaluation more trustworthy.

items.title: Manifold Approximation leads to Robust Kernel Alignment
items.en_title: Manifold Approximation leads to Robust Kernel Alignment
items.en_oneliner: This study finds that improving centered kernel alignment with manifold approximation makes comparing neural network representations and judging model equivalence more robust.

items.title: E0: Expressive Fine-Grained Discrete Action Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models via Tweedie Discrete Diffusion
items.en_title: E0: Expressive Fine-Grained Discrete Action Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models via Tweedie Discrete Diffusion
items.en_oneliner: E0 brings Tweedie discrete diffusion to vision-language-action models so robots can predict finer, more expressive discrete actions in manipulation tasks.

items.title: Model-Free Assessment of Simulator Fidelity via Quantile Curves
items.en_title: Model-Free Assessment of Simulator Fidelity via Quantile Curves
items.en_oneliner: This work proposes quantile curves to measure the sim-to-real gap of generative AI simulators without extra assumptions about the simulator.

items.title: Vision-language models lag human performance on physical dynamics and intent reasoning
items.en_title: Vision-language models lag human performance on physical dynamics and intent reasoning
items.en_oneliner: The study finds vision-language models still lag humans clearly in understanding physical interactions and inferring intent in open scenes, leaving spatial intelligence a weak spot.

items.title: ISLA: Ensemble learning and domain adaptation for generalizable acute ischemic stroke lesion segmentation in diffusion MRI with clinical validation
items.en_title: ISLA: Ensemble learning and domain adaptation for generalizable acute ischemic stroke lesion segmentation in diffusion MRI with clinical validation
items.en_oneliner: ISLA combines ensemble learning and domain adaptation to make acute ischemic stroke lesion segmentation on diffusion MRI more generalizable, with clinical validation confirming its practical value.

items.title: The Alignment Curse: Modality Alignment Supercharges Audio Attacks via Text Transfer
items.en_title: The Alignment Curse: Modality Alignment Supercharges Audio Attacks via Text Transfer
items.en_oneliner: The study finds that when end-to-end omni-models strengthen text-audio modality alignment, attacks crafted for text can transfer to audio, amplifying audio attack risks.

items.title: ESENSC: A Polynomial-Time Axiomatic Alternative to SHAP
items.en_title: ESENSC: A Polynomial-Time Axiomatic Alternative to SHAP
items.en_oneliner: ESENSC replaces SHAP with a deterministic closed-form attribution method, keeping theoretical grounding while bringing interpretability computation down to polynomial time.

items.title: A Variational Latent Equilibrium for Learning in Neuronal Circuits
items.en_title: A Variational Latent Equilibrium for Learning in Neuronal Circuits
items.en_oneliner: This work proposes a variational latent equilibrium framework to explain how brains recognize and generate complex spatiotemporal patterns, offering a new theoretical lens for brain-like learning.

items.title: Comparative Analysis of 3D Convolutional and 2.5D Slice-Conditioned U-Net Architectures for MRI Super-Resolution via Elucidated Diffusion Models
items.en_title: Comparative Analysis of 3D Convolutional and 2.5D Slice-Conditioned U-Net Architectures for MRI Super-Resolution via Elucidated Diffusion Models
items.en_oneliner: This study compares two U-Net architectures for diffusion-driven MRI super-resolution, helping choose the better option for enhancing low-resolution scans.

items.title: FlashSampling: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Sampling
items.en_title: FlashSampling: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Sampling
items.en_oneliner: FlashSampling removes the extra memory traffic that sampling causes in large-vocabulary decoding, making categorical sampling faster and more memory-efficient during inference.

items.title: Generative machine learning for protein design
items.en_title: Generative machine learning for protein design
items.en_oneliner: This review surveys how generative machine learning designs proteins with specific biological functions, covering recent advances for therapeutics and engineered proteins.

items.title: Pruning Extensions and Efficiency Trade-Offs for Sustainable Time Series Classification
items.en_title: Pruning Extensions and Efficiency Trade-Offs for Sustainable Time Series Classification
items.en_oneliner: This study balances predictive performance against resource consumption in time series classification, using pruning extensions to make large-scale classification more sustainable.

items.title: Minimizing classical resources in variational measurement-based quantum computation for generative modeling
items.en_title: Minimizing classical resources in variational measurement-based quantum computation for generative modeling
items.en_oneliner: This work reduces the classical computing resources that variational measurement-based quantum computation needs for generative modeling, bringing quantum generative models closer to practical use.

items.title: Generating Concept Lexicalizations via Dictionary-Based Cross-Lingual Sense Projection
items.en_title: Generating Concept Lexicalizations via Dictionary-Based Cross-Lingual Sense Projection
items.en_oneliner: Through dictionaries, the study projects word senses from one language into another, automatically adding entries for new languages to WordNet-style lexical resources.

items.title: BoostLoRA: Growing Effective Rank by Boosting Adapters
items.en_title: BoostLoRA: Growing Effective Rank by Boosting Adapters
items.en_oneliner: BoostLoRA grows adapters' effective rank through boosting, resolving the tradeoff between ultra-low-parameter adapter size and expressivity.

items.title: Exposing and Mitigating Temporal Attack in Deepfake Video Detection
items.en_title: Exposing and Mitigating Temporal Attack in Deepfake Video Detection
items.en_oneliner: The study reveals that spatiotemporal deepfake detectors, despite high AUC scores, are vulnerable to temporal evasion attacks, and it proposes mitigations for this weakness.

items.title: Wavelet Flow Matching for Multi-Scale Physics Emulation
items.en_title: Wavelet Flow Matching for Multi-Scale Physics Emulation
items.en_oneliner: This work uses wavelet flow matching to emulate multi-scale physical systems governed by PDEs while staying stable over long autoregressive rollouts.

items.title: When Simpler Is Better: Evaluating Translation Pipelines for Medieval Latin Manuscripts
items.en_title: When Simpler Is Better: Evaluating Translation Pipelines for Medieval Latin Manuscripts
items.en_oneliner: The study finds vision-language models struggle with historical manuscripts, while simpler translation pipelines prove more reliable for medieval Latin texts.

items.title: Input Pathways Shape Few-Shot, Not Zero-Shot, Binding in Tiny Transformers: A Fully-Enumerable Study
items.en_title: Input Pathways Shape Few-Shot, Not Zero-Shot, Binding in Tiny Transformers: A Fully-Enumerable Study
items.en_oneliner: This fully-enumerable study finds that how information reaches a transformer — as symbols, clean oracle codes, or entangled perceptual vectors — affects few-shot binding but not zero-shot binding.

items.en_title: Courteous Anticipation: Improving Long-Lived Task Planning in Persistent Shared Environments
items.en_oneliner: This work lets robots sharing a persistent environment courteously anticipate each other's task schedules, improving coordination in long-lived task planning.

items.title: Hidden not Deleted: How Networks Suppress Entangled Features
items.en_title: Hidden not Deleted: How Networks Suppress Entangled Features
items.en_oneliner: The study shows a neural network that stops reporting a feature may simply be hiding it, not forgetting it — a finding with big implications for how shared representations work.

items.en_title: Parameterization method of reservoir properties for ensemble-based data assimilation using intermediate latent space of StyleGAN

items.en_title: Nearly Optimal Fixed-Confidence Best-Arm Identification with 1-Bit Feedback
items.en_oneliner: Working under a strict limit of 1 bit of feedback per round, the study identifies the best arm with near-optimal fixed-confidence guarantees.

items.title: What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation
items.en_title: What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation
items.en_oneliner: This study argues that continual learning wrongly treats any performance drop as forgetting, and that world models should retain knowledge in layers, forgetting selectively as they adapt.

items.title: Learning to Read Out: Unembedding Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
items.en_title: Learning to Read Out: Unembedding Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
items.en_oneliner: This study tracks when a language model acquires a capability during pretraining, finding the key is when its internal readout mechanism forms, not when it first answers correctly.

items.en_title: All Quiet on the Neural Front: Language Models Do Not Report Injected Pain States
items.en_oneliner: This study tests whether a language model can report a pain state it represents, finding that even with an amplifiable pain direction, the model does not report it.

items.title: Before Words, Beyond Speech: Evaluating Nonverbal Social Reasoning in Early Childhood
items.en_title: Before Words, Beyond Speech: Evaluating Nonverbal Social Reasoning in Early Childhood
items.en_oneliner: This study focuses on children's earliest social learning, evaluating how they build meaning through gaze, gesture, and physical contact before words.

items.title: Stochastic Projections and Rank-Aware Learning Rates for Federated LoRA
items.en_title: Stochastic Projections and Rank-Aware Learning Rates for Federated LoRA
items.en_oneliner: This work uses stochastic projections and rank-aware learning rates to tackle the compute and communication challenges of fine-tuning large foundation models across resource-constrained distributed clients.

items.title: Rectified Looped Transformer
items.en_title: Rectified Looped Transformer
items.en_oneliner: Looped Transformers deepen a model by reusing one shared block over and over; this study refines that trick to make the parameter-efficient language-modeling path more dependable.

items.en_title: ZONOS3-Mini Technical Report
items.en_oneliner: ZONOS3-Mini packs zero-shot voice cloning into a tiny, speedy TTS model that runs live on a laptop or phone.
